clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, A Friend of the Family carries a rare likeness of King Terenas to the Cathedral of Light. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon entrusts the Menethil Statuette to an adventurer for Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, who will keep it safe.

King Terenas Menethil II helped shape the Grand Alliance during the Second War and lived with deep personal devotion. Though he held great standing among humanity's kingdoms, he was humble and disliked monuments made in his honor. Few likenesses were commissioned, and fewer survived Lordaeron's ruin and the Scourge's devastation.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sees more than fine carving in the surviving Menethil Statuette. The Holy Light has begun to gather within it, giving the figure a quiet spiritual presence. Bolvar decides Stormwind Keep is no place for such a sacred piece. He sends it across the city to the Cathedral of Light, into the care of Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, who trains paladins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.
The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
